title: Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements III
summary: Given an integer array, determine the least number of increment moves needed to make all elements equal by increasing any single element by one in each move.
statement: Given an integer array, determine the least number of increment moves needed to make all elements equal by increasing any single element by one in each move.

Return the minimum moves needed to make every element equal.
